Course Name: Python for Beginners
Category: Programming
Difficulty: Beginner
Prerequisites: Basic computer knowledge
Skills: Python, Programming Fundamentals
Learning Outcomes: Write Python programs, Understand variables, loops and functions, Work with basic data structures

Course Name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
Category: Artificial Intelligence
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: Python, Basic Mathematics, Basic Statistics
Skills: Machine Learning, Python, Statistics
Learning Outcomes: Understand supervised and unsupervised learning, Build basic machine learning models, Evaluate machine learning models

Course Name: Deep Learning with Neural Networks
Category: Artificial Intelligence
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: Python, Machine Learning Fundamentals
Skills: Deep Learning, Neural Networks, PyTorch
Learning Outcomes: Understand neural networks, Build deep learning models, Work with PyTorch

Course Name: Generative AI and LLMs
Category: Generative AI
Difficulty: Advanced
Prerequisites: Python, Machine Learning Fundamentals, Deep Learning
Skills: Generative AI, LLMs, Transformers, RAG
Learning Outcomes: Understand Large Language Models, Understand Transformer architecture, Build basic RAG applications

Course Name: Natural Language Processing Fundamentals
Category: Artificial Intelligence
Difficulty: Advanced
Prerequisites: Python, Machine Learning Fundamentals, Deep Learning
Skills: NLP, Text Processing, Natural Language Processing
Learning Outcomes: Understand natural language processing, Process and analyze text data, Build basic NLP applications

Course Name: Computer Vision Fundamentals
Category: Artificial Intelligence
Difficulty: Advanced
Prerequisites: Python, Machine Learning Fundamentals, Deep Learning
Skills: Computer Vision, Image Processing, OpenCV
Learning Outcomes: Understand computer vision concepts, Process images using Python, Build basic computer vision applications

Course Name: Data Science Fundamentals
Category: Data Science
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: Python, Basic Statistics
Skills: Data Science, Data Analysis, Statistics, Pandas
Learning Outcomes: Understand data science workflows, Analyze datasets using Python, Work with Pandas and basic data analysis

Course Name: LLM Application Development
Category: Generative AI
Difficulty: Advanced
Prerequisites: Python, Generative AI and LLMs
Skills: LLM Applications, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents
Learning Outcomes: Build applications using LLMs, Apply prompt engineering techniques, Build RAG and agent-based applications

Course Name: AWS Cloud Foundations
Category: Cloud Computing
Difficulty: Beginner
Prerequisites: Basic computer knowledge
Skills: AWS, Cloud Computing
Learning Outcomes: Understand cloud computing concepts, Understand AWS core services, Deploy basic cloud applications

Course Name: AWS Solutions Architect Fundamentals
Category: Cloud Computing
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: AWS Cloud Foundations
Skills: AWS, Cloud Architecture
Learning Outcomes: Design basic AWS architectures, Understand scalability and availability, Select appropriate AWS services

Course Name: DevOps Fundamentals
Category: DevOps
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: AWS Cloud Foundations
Skills: DevOps, CI/CD, Cloud
Learning Outcomes: Understand DevOps principles, Understand CI/CD pipelines, Understand cloud-based development workflows

Course Name: Docker and Container Fundamentals
Category: DevOps
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: DevOps Fundamentals
Skills: Docker, Containers, Containerization
Learning Outcomes: Understand containerization, Create Docker containers, Build and manage container images

Course Name: Kubernetes Fundamentals
Category: DevOps
Difficulty: Advanced
Prerequisites: Docker and Container Fundamentals
Skills: Kubernetes, Container Orchestration
Learning Outcomes: Understand Kubernetes architecture, Deploy applications to Kubernetes, Manage containerized workloads

Course Name: AWS DevOps Fundamentals
Category: DevOps
Difficulty: Advanced
Prerequisites: AWS Solutions Architect Fundamentals, Docker and Container Fundamentals
Skills: AWS DevOps, CI/CD, Cloud Deployment
Learning Outcomes: Understand AWS DevOps services, Build cloud CI/CD pipelines, Deploy applications using AWS

Course Name: SQL and Database Fundamentals
Category: Data Science
Difficulty: Beginner
Prerequisites: Basic computer knowledge
Skills: SQL, Databases, Database Fundamentals
Learning Outcomes: Write basic SQL queries, Understand relational databases, Retrieve and manipulate database records

Course Name: Data Analytics with Python
Category: Data Science
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: Python, SQL and Database Fundamentals, Basic Statistics
Skills: Python Data Analysis, Pandas, Data Visualization, SQL
Learning Outcomes: Analyze datasets using Python, Create data visualizations, Perform exploratory data analysis

Course Name: Web Development Fundamentals
Category: Web Development
Difficulty: Beginner
Prerequisites: Basic computer knowledge
Skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Development
Learning Outcomes: Build basic web pages, Understand HTML and CSS, Understand JavaScript fundamentals

Course Name: Backend Development with Python
Category: Web Development
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: Python, Web Development Fundamentals
Skills: Python Backend, APIs, Backend Development
Learning Outcomes: Build backend applications using Python, Create basic REST APIs, Understand backend application architecture

Course Name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
Category: Cybersecurity
Difficulty: Beginner
Prerequisites: Basic computer knowledge
Skills: Cybersecurity, Network Security, Security Fundamentals
Learning Outcomes: Understand cybersecurity fundamentals, Understand common security threats, Understand basic network security concepts

Course Name: Cloud Security Fundamentals
Category: Cybersecurity
Difficulty: Intermediate
Prerequisites: AWS Cloud Foundations, Cybersecurity Fundamentals
Skills: Cloud Security, AWS Security, Security Architecture
Learning Outcomes: Understand cloud security principles, Understand AWS security concepts, Apply basic cloud security practices
